verdict.rationale: Meltano's docs say it supports scheduled pipelines orchestrated with Apache Airflow, so recurring background runs are a documented capability. Incremental state tracking lets repeated runs resume where they left off, and built-in monitoring and alerts support unattended operation. Scheduling depends on Airflow and is described in a single line, while `meltano run` is a one-off command, not a recurring schedule. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of schedule configuration and background execution, any agentic or AI-driven automation beyond fixed ELT schedules, and independent hands-on corroboration of scheduled runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Meltano supports scheduled pipelines that can be orchestrated using Apache Airflow.
keeps track of the incremental replication state, so that subsequent pipeline runs with the same state ID will always pick up right where the previous run left off
